Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal.block

Class BlockInterner

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.block.BlockInterner
@Internal public final class BlockInterner extends Object
Shares what BlockNetworkIds.HASHED palettes of different versions have in common: vanilla RegisteredBlockStates (a state has the same hash in every version) and pages of canonical id tables with equal content. One per Paletter.

Internal: shared between Paletter's packages, not API.

Only vanilla content is interned, which is bounded by the bundled versions; custom blocks of (possibly short lived) layers are not, so session palettes do not accumulate here.
